tools.name: convert_statement
tools.description: Starts converting one bank or credit-card statement (PDF, scanned image, CSV, QIF, OFX/QFX) into reconciled transactions on the user's stmtai account. Pass the bytes as file_base64 (about 4 MB at most) or as an attached file object; with neither, the result is an upload_required handshake holding a

tools.name: get_conversion
tools.description: Reports the state of one conversion: "processing" while it runs, "error" with the reason when it failed (nothing charged), or "done" with a summary: file name, bank, account last digits, statement period, reconciliation outcome (balanced, unbalanced or unverifiable) and difference, transaction count

tools.name: get_download_link
tools.description: Creates a download link (valid 15 minutes, no sign-in needed to open it) for a finished conversion in one of these formats: xlsx, csv, xero, qbo, qbcsv, tally, report. xlsx is an Excel workbook with transactions, summary and categories; csv is Date, Description, Money Out, Money In, Amount, Balance,

tools.name: list_conversions
tools.description: Lists the user's finished conversions, newest first (default 20, at most 50): conversion id, file name, when it was converted, reconciliation status, pages read, transaction count and when the result expires (results are kept 7 days unless the user deletes them earlier).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Shows the signed-in stmtai account: email, plan, subscription status, monthly page allowance, pages remaining this month (plan and pages-pack) and when the monthly counter resets. An account that has never converted anything reports the Free plan without a remaining count.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account · Private data: convert_statement, get_conversion, get_download_link, list_conversions · Public sink: convert_statement, get_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account · Private data: convert_statement, get_conversion, get_download_link, list_conversions · Public sink: convert_statement, get_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
